about: The tractus of the formulary “Chair of Saint Peter the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You are Peter, and on this rock I will build My Church. And the gates of the underworld will not prevail against it; and I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will also be bound in heaven. And whatever you loose on earth will also be loosed in heaven.
